def: Any method, such as DPO, IPO, KTO, ORPO or SimPO, that trains on preference data with a closed-form loss instead of a separate reward model and an RL loop.
practice: Cheaper and more stable than PPO-based RLHF, but offline versions learn only from the pairs they are given and still overoptimize, as Rafailov et al. (2024) showed.
